messages:
Liam (CSM): FYI  Saltmarsh dedicated bring-up tomorrow 07:30 PT. Committed: 16 GPUs, split across 2 pools (north/south). Target steady ~6k qps, burst to 14k. Need final signoff on autoscale params, priming plan, and post-run renewal signal.
Eve (SRE): Ill run the ramp and smoke. Proposed window 07:30 09:00 PT: priming 20m, steady 50m @6k, then two 10m bursts (9k then 14k). Load tool: `rb-load --profile saltmarsh_steady --qps 6000 --duration 3000`. Streaming metrics to #eng-sre.
Noah (SE): I'll do prefix + KV seed. Command: `rbw-seed --pool=north,south --concurrency=45 --duration=1200`. Also recommend persisting KV on north for long-context jobs. Will run a forced cold-start on one replica during the second burst.
Liam (CSM): We need 1.15x headroom for autoscale during bursts and a soft-fallback to hosted variant `redwood-hosted/eco-small` if max_replicas reached. Also schedule a 15:00 PT enablement runbook walk after the test.
Eve (SRE): Autoscale settings suggested: min_replicas=2, target_utilization=0.6, max_replicas=20, scale_up_step=3, stabilization=90s, scale_down_stable=480s. Fallback route configured to hosted; will validate in chaos test.
Noah (SE): I'll add an instance-kill test: kill replica on pool south at peak to observe routing and KV rehydration. Also will collect 7k sample outputs (steady+burst) for quick evals.
Tara (PM): Two asks: 1) capture per-route p50/p95/p99 and error-rate; 2) record model drift notes for the 7k evals and flag tokenization anomalies. If p95 > 280ms or errors >0.7% we mark the renewal as at-risk pending root cause.
Liam (CSM): I'll coordinate the customer enablement invite and renewal note if we see cost > forecasted by 10% during the run. Also confirm billing cap request?
billing-bot: temporary_quota_increase saltmarsh -> approved amount=$1500 window=2026-05-10T14:30:00Z tag=SALTWARMUP
Eve (SRE): Monitoring metrics to watch: `inference.latency_ms`, `gpu_util_pct`, `kv_hit_ratio`, `http_5xx_rate`, `tokens_per_sec`. Alerts: p95 latency >=300ms OR 5xx_rate >=0.5% => page oncall. Grafana link will follow.
Noah (SE): Runbook excerpt:
```
# seed
rbw-seed --pool north,south --concurrency 45 --duration 1200
# steady
rb-load --profile saltmarsh_steady --qps 6000 --duration 3000 --out ./reports/salt_steady.json
# bursts
rb-load --profile saltmarsh_burst_short --qps 9000 --duration 600
rb-load --profile saltmarsh_burst_peak --qps 14000 --duration 600
```
Liam (CSM): Action items:
- Eve: run the load window 07:30-09:00 PT, stream metrics to #eng-sre, abort if p95>320ms or 5xx>1%
- Noah: seed KV 20m prior, run kill/fallback during second burst, attach 7k sample outputs
- Tara: prepare drift evaluation script and quick-report template by 07:00 PT
- Liam: host 15:00 PT enablement + renewal sync, capture feedback in CS tracker
Noah (SE): I'll also post the pool IDs, KMS key names, and the autoscale JSON in this thread in 5m. :thumbsup:
Eve (SRE): If we see sustained tail latencies >350ms we'll throttle the second burst and re-run a controlled pass. I'll upload logs and dashboards after the run.
Liam (CSM): Thanks team  this thread is canonical. Ping me immediately for keys/billing or customer-facing failures.
infra-bot: scheduled_job saltmarsh-warmup -> queued for 2026-05-10T14:30:00Z
